# Posts fixtures

Captured from the live sites on 2026-11-15 with a real browser, then trimmed to the first few
entries of each index page, markup as sent minus images.

- `nwff_news.html`: https://nwfilmforum.org/news/
- `siff_blog.html`: https://www.siff.net/media/blog
- `siff_news.html`: https://www.siff.net/media/news-x39250 (press releases; the index has no dates,
  so these posts sort by the date they were first seen).
- `beacon_series.html`, `beacon_programs.html`: https://thebeacon.film/series and /programs. Series
  carry no dates anywhere; programs carry a month ("NOVEMBER 2026").
- `beacon_program_surplus-reality.html`: the film links from one program page (for the film count).
- `beacon_series_shadowland.html`: a series page (description and film links).
- `siff_programs.html`: https://www.siff.net/programs-and-events (Happening Now).
- `nwff_series.html`, `nwff_festivals.html`: https://nwfilmforum.org/series/ and /festivals/ (Happening Now).
- `beacon_program_love-is-a-country.html`: a Coming Soon program page (image, description, films).
- `beacon_program_in-the-midst.html`, `beacon_series_double-features.html`: a past program and the past
  series (photo and first sentence for the Past Programs page).
